content: More generally, medical QA systems should follow some strict guidelines regarding the goal and background knowledge and resources of each system in order to protect the consumers from misleading or harmful information. Such guidelines could be based (i) on the source of the information such as health and medical information websites sponsored by the U.S. government, not-for-profit health or medical organizations, and medical university centers, or (ii) on conventions such as the code of conduct of the HON Foundation (HONcode) that addresses the reliability and usefulness of medical information on the Internet.
